resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register location line says Lawrence County; Indiana Fire Towers says Martin County; Wikipedia says the base is mostly in Martin County with small parts in Lawrence County. The record is left as it is for the editor to decide.

notes_for_editor: The 1938 build year rests only on a personal resource quoted by Indiana Fire Towers, so the event is kept with that caveat. The 1938 date falls before the 1941 depot founding, a gap no source read explains. USFS says the tower was used until the mid 1970s but gives no exact year, so no dated event was added for that. No staffing or notable fire was found in the sources read. Status and access come from Indiana Fire Towers' February 2025 visit; nothing newer was checked. The Register's Lawrence County entry disagrees with Indiana Fire Towers and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list (Martin); the brief's county was not changed. Not verified: any restoration, closure or change since February 2025.
